117: After the insane General Jack D. Ripper initiates a nuclear strike on the Soviet Union, a war room full of politicians, generals and a Russian diplomat all frantically try to stop it.
Group Capt. Lionel Mandrake / President Merkin Muffley / Dr. Strangelove

629: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. 885: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader. 1141: In the final months of World War II, 14-year-old Seita and his sister Setsuko are orphaned when their mother is killed during an air raid in Kobe, Japan. After a falling out with their aunt, they move into an abandoned bomb shelter. With no surviving relatives and their emergency rations depleted, Seita and Setsuko struggle to survive.
Why do fireflies have to die so soon?
Woman who takes care of Setsuko (voice)
1397: A graphic portrayal of the last twelve hours of Jesus of Nazareth's life.
By his wounds, we were healed.
1653: Lifelong platonic friends Zack and Miri look to solve their respective cash-flow problems by making an adult film together. As the cameras roll, however, the duo begin to sense that they may have more feelings for each other than they previously thought.
What would you do to get out of debt?
1909: The seeds of love are planted when Lisa, a high-powered investment banker, receives flowers from a secret admirer. But when his fairy-tale fantasies clash with her workaholic ways, they soon find out that sometimes, it's harder than it seems for love to conquer all.
He gave her flowers. She gave him a chance.

Behind the mystery lies a truth that will make you question everything you know.
2421: Half-human, half-Atlantean Arthur Curry is taken on the journey of his lifetime to discover if he is worth of being a king.
2677: Vampire Lestat awakens from his slumber and becomes a rock star. But chaos strikes when his music awakens Akasha, the vampire queen, who may not rest until she makes Lestat her new king.
2933: A nice guy has just moved to New York and discovers that he must share his run-down apartment with a couple thousand singing, dancing cockroaches.
3189: A kindhearted street urchin named Aladdin embarks on a magical adventure after finding a lamp that releases a wisecracking genie while a power-hungry Grand Vizier vies for the same lamp that has the power to make their deepest wishes come true.
3445: After the disastrous food storm in the first film, Flint and his friends are forced to leave the town. 3701: Jay Austin is now a civilian police detective. Colonel Caldwell was his commanding officer years before when he left the military police over a disagreement over the handling of a drunk driver. He didn't want to share the murder investigation. There's no way he's going to share his daughter.
3957: Mike is an unmotivated stoner whose small-town life with his live-in girlfriend, Phoebe, is suddenly turned upside down.  Unbeknownst to him, Mike is actually a highly trained, lethal sleeper agent. 4213: A high school swim champion with a troubled past enrolls in the U.S. Coast Guard's 'A' School, where legendary rescue swimmer Ben Randall teaches him some hard lessons about loss, love, and self-sacrifice.
How do you decide who lives or who dies?
4469: A low-ranking thug is entrusted by his boss to dispose of a gun that killed corrupt cops, but things spiral out of control when the gun ends up in wrong hands.
4725: A rude, contemptuous talk show host becomes overwhelmed by the hatred that surrounds his program just before it goes national.
4981: Aging pals Billy, Paddy, Archie, and Sam have been best friends since childhood. However, the four quickly realize that the intervening decades have changed Sin City and tested their friendship in ways they had not imagined.
5237: Stockholm, in the 1950s.  Erik is expelled from the local school for getting into one brawl too many. It's time to take a stand.
5493: A young college student who’s struggling financially takes a strange babysitting job which coincides with a full lunar eclipse. She slowly realizes her clients harbor a terrifying secret, putting her life in mortal danger.
Talk on the phone. Finish your homework. Watch TV. Die.

Their intentions were honorable. Their methods were criminal.
6005: An estranged family gathers together in New York for an event celebrating the artistic work of their father.
6261: A psychoanalyst and his family go through profound emotional trauma when their son dies in a scuba diving accident.
6517: Nadine and Manu are two mad women, as tidy as can be, almost perfectionists. They have several things in common: extreme sex, drugs, beer and the trigger. They find the solution to their problems with guns and beware to those who dare to get in their way!
Art or Pornography? You be the judge! Complete and Uncut the most controversial film of all time...A hard-core Thelma & Louise.
6773: In 1967, experimental filmmaker Jorgen Leth created a striking short film, The Perfect Human, starring a man and women sitting in a box while a narrator poses questions about their relationship and humanity. Voice-over (from Det perfekte menneske) / Self - Director / +
The Perfect Man (from Det perfekte menneske) (archive footage)
The Perfect Woman (from Det perfekte menneske) (archive footage)

This is the dawning of the Age of Colossus (where peace is compulsory... freedom is forbidden... and Man's greatest invention could be Man's greatest mistake).

7541: In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.
8053: When the gang from the Hundred Acre Wood begin a honey harvest, young Piglet is excluded and told that he is too small to help. 8309: A young medical student struggling to pay tuition is drawn into the shady world of underground body-modification.

A great human story... makes a mighty motion picture!
8821: Following the latest Ghostface killings, the four survivors leave Woodsboro behind and start a fresh chapter.

Griffith is imprisoned in the oldest building in Wyndham Catle, the Tower of Rebirth.
9845: A pair of well-meaning, but socially inept brothers try to find their perfect mates in order to provide their dying father with a grandchild.
They want to put a baby in you.
10101: It's the day before Christmas, the day before John's 21st birthday. You will not feel the terror until you experience the movie!
10613: Australian teenager Heidi is left with little choice but to leave home after she's caught red-handed with her mother's boyfriend. Love can turn you upside down.
10869: Two rival bikers gangs, the Victors and the Six-Six-Six's, refuel their decades-old rivalry.
The rebellion against all there is
11125: In a small town on Christmas Eve, a snowstorm brings together a group of young people. They soon find their friendships and love lives colliding, and come Christmas morning, nothing will be the same.
Let love take you by storm.

In a game of life and death... one wrong move could be his last...
11893: The war between Luxembourg and Finland sets the outline to a set of comedic stories about a rally team, gay couple's fishing trip, two hoodlums' last school days in the spring and a haunted hotel among others.

A story from the heart of America...to thrill America's heart!

Doing the right thing the wrong way.
12917: Scientists Richard Dawkins and Lawrence Krauss travel the globe promoting a scientific worldview and the rational questioning of religious belief.
What are you willing to believe?
13173: An array of outrageous people, including a desperate nymphomaniac and a terrorist with an acute sense of smell, seek love and happiness in Madrid.

He could beat any white man in the world. He just couldn't beat all of them.

Things are not as straight-forward as they initially appeared.
14453: The re-imagining of VE Day in 1945, when Princess Elizabeth and her sister, Margaret were allowed out from Buckingham Palace for the night to join in the celebrations, and encounter romance and danger.
V-E Day, 1945. Princesses Elizabeth and Margaret escape the palace for...
14709: Four young people navigate the suburban wonderland of metro-Detroit looking for love and adventure on the last weekend of summer.
14965: Assigned to recover sensitive stolen data, a gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher, but the school's liberal, politically correct environment is more than he bargained for.

Everyone needs a refuge from the world.
15477: The parents of a girl who was killed by a savage dog are granted the opportunity to spend three days with their deceased daughter.
Beware Those You Love the Most

Nobody loves me except the acacia tree.

He Turned Innocent Beauty Into Unspeakable Horror.

Pray for us sinners now and at the hour of our death.

Too young? Too old? You do the math.

Nobody plays rougher than The Outfit...
19317: A group of travelers is stranded in a small country inn when the river floods during heavy rains. As the bad weather continues, tensions rise amongst the trapped travelers.
19573: Robinson, a once peaceful, law-abiding school teacher, has turned into an obsessed vengeance machine, intent on killing the man who murdered his wife - ruthless Las Vegas mob boss James Dolan. 19829: College town life gets turned upside down after a button-down botany professor secretly weds a sizzling night-club singer.
Ginger goes to college but not the way you think
20341: The true story of a part Aboriginal man who finds the pressure of adapting to white culture intolerable, and as a result snaps in a violent and horrific manner.
20597: When a sexy, high-end escort holds the key evidence to a scandalous government cover-up, two bumbling young detectives become her unlikely protectors from a ruthless assassin hired to silence her.
20853: After being kidnapped by four masked men, a teacher and her students rebel by plotting against the criminals.
For one teacher and nine children, the lesson of the day is kill or be killed.
21109: After the accidental death of her rapist, an art student becomes an unlikely vigilante, set out to avenge college girls whose rapists were not charged.
21365: The Austrian Secret Service sends its most seductive agent to spy on the Russians.
Can a Woman Kill a Man With Whom She Has Known a Night of Love?
21621: Three recent high school grads - star athlete Hancock, his cheerleader girlfriend, Mary, and the awkward Senator - aim to leave their small town behind and realize big dreams, but their idealistic plans collide with life's harsh realities.
Life on the edge of the American Dream.

The suspense-tense surprise of the year!
22389: A meek young man must find the courage within when a rogue tramp menaces his hometown.
Where Laughter Reigns and Joy Pours!
22645: A woman's chaotic life becomes more complicated when she inherits her grandmother's dog.
22901: When the host of a failing children’s science show tries to fulfill his childhood dream of becoming an astronaut by building a rocket ship in his garage, a series of bizarre events occur that cause him to question his own reality.
23157: Max finds himself in possession of an ancient scroll that describes the entire history of humankind from beginning to end. Seeking to use the information for his own gain, Max triggers the mechanism that begins influencing his own life.
Man - Small World. World - Giant Man.
23413: As New York City is invaded by alien creatures who hunt by sound, a woman named Sam fights to survive with her cat.
23669: Set in 1960s India, Archie and the gang navigate romance, friendship and the future of Riverdale as developers threaten to destroy a beloved park.

At the end of the world, no one survives alone.
24181: A honest cop tries to track down the brain behind a series of robberies and murders, but things turn personal when his family become pawns in the criminal's game.
Power is a State of Mind
24437: A bounty hunter in present day, learns about his previous life as a legendary warrior, when fate unites him with a mutant kid.
24693: A father doesn't want his three daughters to get married. Now, it's up to three men to try to and convince the father that they're a good fit for his daughters.
24949: From a schoolboy’s crush to a middle-aged bachelor’s office romance, four love stories spanning age, religion and status unfold in a small Indian town.
25205: When a temple priest commits suicide after being dishonored by an evil landlord, his son returns to his native village on a mission of vengeance.
25461: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.
They unleashed their deadliest weapon on us.
25717: A policewoman makes her ex-boyfriend an offer he can't refuse: either he infiltrates and informs on a gang of hooligans, or his brother goes to jail.
25973: Based on the true story of teenager James Burns who goes from a suburban street gang to a maximum-security prison cell surrounded by hardened criminals. He turns his life around in prison thanks to the unexpected friendship he forms with a convicted murderer who becomes his mentor.
26229: An agoraphobic hip-hop prodigy and a disgraced former music manager cross paths in Chicago’s South Side and help each other face demons of their pasts.
26485: An unsettling look at reality television, where a disturbing game show has its contestants ending their lives for the public's enjoyment.
It's a matter of life and death.
26741: Two years after the murder of his son and father, a retired hitman sets in motion a carefully crafted revenge plan against the killer: his own brother.
Running away is not an option. Revenge is his only plan.
26997: As he transfers a young convict from prison to court, a police officer learns about the chain of events that led to the young man's conviction for violence.
27253: In Brazil, Akemi finds out that she's the heiress to the Yakuza empire. Just after that, her destiny enters a spiral of violence and mystery, where a gaijin (foreigner) who's been protecting her all this time, Shirô, may have been actually sent to kill her.
27509: Craving a fresh start, recently unemployed Agneta accepts an au pair gig in Provence that turns into an indulgent escape — and an unexpected awakening.
27765: Barcelona, ​​Spain, 1921. A tough cop from Madrid arrives in the city to locate, under the suspicious scrutiny of corrupt local police officers, a significant amount of military weaponry stolen from a train, allegedly by revolutionary anarchists.
1921. Some dream of a better world.

Grief can be a funny thing.
28533: Rachit Ram, heir to a multi-billion-dollar corporate conglomerate, sets off on his journey to fulfill a daunting challenge of living like a commoner for 100 days in the middle of nowhere with absolutely no money and privileges, while his aunt and cousin brother conspire together to make him fail his challenge.
28789: The most feared battle emcee in the early 1980s in Queens, New York, was a fierce teenager from the Queensbridge projects. 29045: Professor Niyazi Gül is an animal-loving veterinarian who possesses the unique ability to speak with animals. Living a quiet life in İzmir while developing a secret formula with his assistant, Hediye, his world is turned upside down when Sultan and Rıza drag him into a chaotic horse racing scheme.
29301: Times are hard for habitual guest of Her Majesty Norman Stanley Fletcher. The new prison officer, Beale, makes MacKay look soft and what's more, an escape plan is hatching from the cell of prison godfather Grouty and Fletcher wants no part of it.
Fletcher's inside story - even funnier as a film
29813: Julie is a new mom and children's book author, who escapes into the bright Crayola-colored world of her creation in order to leave behind the darkness caused by her post-partum depression.
30069: A tale of the tender relationship between a twelve-year-old boy and the fourteen-year-old upperclassman who is the object of his desire, all set within the rigid atmosphere of a Jesuit-run school.

Fear a meaningless life, not death itself.

Suddenly she is abducted by a military squad and finds herself accused of subversion and submitted to torture in the hideous underground of the Garage Olimpo, while her mother desperately tries to find her.
31349: When aspiring musician and student Deniz falls for a rough-hewn motorbike racer, tragedy and family opposition obstruct their path to love.
31605: Fisher Willow is the disliked Memphis débutante daughter of a plantation owner with a distaste for narrow-minded people and a penchant for shocking and insulting those around her. 32117: Matthias is a master of pretense, from cultured boyfriend to perfect son or marital coach. He makes a career of being someone else. The real challenge begins when he has to be himself.
32373: Prince Danilo falls in love with dancer Sally O'Hara. However, his uncle, King Nikita I of Monteblanco, forbids the marriage due to her being a commoner. 32629: Socially-conscious banker Thomas Dickson faces a crisis when his protégé is wrongly accused of robbing the bank, gossip of the robbery starts a bank run, and evidence suggests Dickson's wife had an affair... all in the same day.
The Great American Picture of Today!
32885: After his pregnant wife killed by thinner addicts, Ersin Balkan, decides on to establish a school for children who are abandoned ad thinner addicts. Noticing that he can not afford  a such thing with his salary,  takes a new career and becomes a singer.
